# Kanwar Arcade

> Free browser games by Kanwar Afaq. 5 games, no downloads, no accounts, no ads. Scores are saved only in the player's own browser.

## Games
- [Starfall](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/starfall.html): Starfall is a free space shooter you can play in your browser. Dodge, shoot, grab power-ups and beat the boss.
- [Brick Rally](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/brick-rally.html): Brick Rally is a free brick-breaker you can play in your browser. Five levels, power-ups and a streak multiplier.
- [Serpentine](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/serpentine.html): Serpentine is a free snake game for your browser with smooth glowing graphics, combo fruit and rocks to dodge. Play with arrow keys or swipe.
- [Skyhop](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/skyhop.html): Skyhop is a free one-tap flying game for your browser. Flap through gaps, collect stars and fly from sunrise into the night.
- [Lumenfall](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/lumenfall.html): Lumenfall is a free 3D adventure that runs in your browser. Explore Crystal Valley, fight enemies, find nine energy crystals and reach the final portal.
